d.ko:
A spy-chicken tries to save the world from doom in this runner/shooter game that has a little bit of everything with a touch of chicken and anime girls on top.
Run for your life in 6 different worlds and shoot your way through tons of enemies until you become a legend.

I got it on sale for a dollar and dont think I got my moneys worth. I beat the first boss and then just got bored instantly. The controls feel awful and slow and everything is meh. Reasonably priced but not my thing.
